meta.limitations: Footprints are machine detections, not a cadastral survey. Heights, roof colors and facades are illustrative. Individual trees are decorative within OSM parks/tree rows, streets and ESA 2021 tree-cover areas. Park paths and regional roof materials are schematic, refined from user-supplied aerial reference images. Landcover resolution is 10 m and may be outdated. No imagery files are embedded or redistributed; building and road outlines remain from OSM/Microsoft.
